name: Masikah
description: A tall, barrel-chested man of the Ahn crop who doubts that the God-Pharaoh is a lie.

timeline.summary: Samut tells the survivors that the God-Pharaoh is a lie and a trespasser, and Masikah doubts her.
timeline.quote: He is a trespasser, an interloper from another world.

pages_say.description: A tall, barrel-chested man of the Ahn crop who doubts that the God-Pharaoh is a lie.
